_comment: Config for the HOSTED multi-tenant deployment that serves *.all-ai-network.org. One build serves every chapter, so identity comes from the hostname (canonicalSlug in src/main.ts) and content from the dashboard bundle. Two deliberate rules here. (1) Sample officers/events/content are EMPTY ARRAYS: they are fallbacks, and on a shared deployment a fallback is somebody else's chapter showing Alex Johnson as its president. (2) Name, acronym, tagline, about and university are OMITTED, not blanked. main.ts resolves them with `remote ?? config ?? hardcoded default`, and `??` only falls through on null — so an empty string here would defeat its own defaults and leave a chapter with no tagline and no acronym rather than a sensible generic one.
